answer: Acting costs one assay card per identity per epoch, destroyed by its reaction. Each card is an ivory slip whose grain enters an atlas when issued, with a vine reagent patch that ferments as it reacts, so its color curve shifts under a live hash. Checkers match curve and grain to the atlas entry for that serial; duplicate serials, replayed curves, or grain mismatches are proof of forgery, voiding the identity, and a split patch fails, its halved reagent out of band. An honest agent burns one card per epoch; 1,000 fakes burn 1,000 slips per epoch, each locking a 60-unit deposit for 10 epochs.
